description:
## Goal

Two skills in prompt-manager that make adding a tool cheap and fleet adoption visible.

## Expected Work

- `tool-authoring` skill: step-by-step guide for adding a new tool to a scenario using the shared toolkit. Includes the canonical file layout, how to wire registration, how to test.
- `tool-adoption-audit` skill: fleet scan producing a report of which scenarios expose tools, how many per scenario, and any drift flagged by the scenario-auditor rule.

## Acceptance

- Both skills land in `scenarios/prompt-manager/store/skills/packs/core/` with proper SKILL.md formatting.
- Authoring skill is concrete enough that an agent following it can add a working tool end-to-end.
name: tool-authoring-prompt-manager-skills
title: Author `tool-authoring` and `tool-adoption-audit` prompt-manager skills
